entry.title: P's Pocket
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$14.99 → $9.99 [$9.99 ~ $14.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$9.99

Application Description

Bring your virtual pets along on iPhone and iPad. Import compatible firmware, care for your pets, and keep each device's progress in your cabinet. Or start with Pocochi, the original playable game included in the app. • A little help from Pocochi Choose a character to aim for and see current stats, growth goals, and care suggestions based on your game records. Tap the mascot to speed up dialogue, or hold it to open goals and progress. Firmware-specific guidance requires supported imported firmware. • An album of your time together Record characters you encounter and raise, collected pieces, achievements, and growth milestones. Make a postcard from a character's page or create a group card. Choose a background, share the result, or save it as an image or Live Photo. Artwork for compatible games is read from your imported firmware; Pocochi uses original artwork. • One cabinet, independent devices Create up to 20 pet devices, each with its own progress and appearance. Tap a device's title to view details or rename it; hold and drag to organize. Play up to four devices in split screen. With two devices, rotate one for face-to-face play. • Play with friends nearby Choose multiplayer inside a compatible game and the app connects automatically. Lend or return a device face to face: the lender's copy stays locked until it returns with the latest progress. Pocochi does not support game-to-game multiplayer. • Look through game records View current pet details, care stats, friends, items, collections, and photo diaries. Available information depends on your firmware and saved records. • Care at your own pace Real-time Growth accounts for time away. Attentive Care pauses at supported calls or new care events and waits for you to return. With permission, local notifications can report events during background updates. iOS schedules background work, so updates and notifications may be delayed; continuous operation and fixed notification times are not guaranteed. • Make yourself at home Choose a minimal or detailed 3D shell, different colors, a full-device view or a larger screen, and an optional LCD filter. Add screen widgets in several sizes or a separate button widget. The interface follows your system's light or dark appearance. • Keep your progress Progress saves automatically. Optional iCloud backup and whole-app restore include your cabinet, games, and player profile. You can also back up individual devices to a folder you choose. If something goes wrong, export a diagnostic report, choose whether to attach one device's save, and decide where to save or send it. Reports are never uploaded automatically. Interactive lessons help you get started and learn individual features. You can exit and revisit them whenever you like. Commercial game firmware is not included. To play those games, import a compatible, complete original firmware file that you are entitled to use. Chinese interfaces offer an optional Simplified Chinese patch for matching imported firmware. A Traditional Chinese firmware patch is not currently available, and some content may remain in its original language.

Application Description

Po Jun: Three Kingdoms is a landscape-mode strategy masterpiece designed exclusively for hardcore tacticians. Limited-time download event is ending soon. Event benefits include: - Exclusive Avatar Frame for Pioneer Users; - Retain the privilege of recruiting initial SS generals using common resources; - 498 Prestige Unlimited Pack (2.5x value), retained even after restarting the game; - Bonus VIP 3 benefits; - All original gameplay experience remains unchanged; Benefits will be automatically issued after the 1.4.0 update. New users downloading after 1.4.0 goes live will not be eligible. Download now to get ready! The battlefield is your chessboard; the outcome is in your hands! This time, reject numerical crushing and return to the essence of strategy! We abandon mindless stat-checking, perfectly fusing broad-scale SLG grand strategy with high-precision RTS micro-control. Here, victory isn't bought with money, but earned through your mastery of troop types, ingenious schemes, and environmental factors. 【Real-Time Command: Landscape RTS & Micro-Control】 Say goodbye to "spectator-style" auto-battles! We introduce a revolutionary joystick-based real-time command system, allowing you to control heroes with precision amidst massive frontline clashes. Remember: back attacks deal massive bonus damage, and flanking maneuvers maximize your tactical advantage! Flip the script through encirclements and ambushes! 【Ingenious Reversals: Supply Lines & Dynamic Weather】 Only those who read the heavens prevail! A dynamic weather system directly alters battlefield data: mud in the rain slows cavalry, clear skies boost vision and range, and snow penalizes both attack and movement. Foggy nights provide the perfect window for a surprise raid! Furthermore, the unique "Granary System" is your lifeline—capturing the enemy’s granary will collapse their army’s morale and combat power instantly. 【Strategic Mastery: Tactics & Intelligent Deployment】 Numerical superiority is no guarantee of victory! Deploy schemes like Defection, Sow Discord, or Internal Agents to make enemies turn on each other. Beyond fine micro-control, you can preset global strategies: Attack, Balance, Defense, or Retreat. Your army will fight according to your logic while you control key units to take the enemy general's head! 【Sandbox World: Dynamic Power Struggles】 Execute long-term plans on a panoramic sandbox map. Expand your borders through conquest and garrisoning. Your every troop movement and resource grab will shift the global balance of power in real-time. Engage with deep AI in a world that breathes and reacts to your choices! 【Troop Evolution: Multi-Dimensional Counters & Military Research】 Infantry, Cavalry, Spearmen, and Archers counter each other in a tactical loop. Legendary special units like Elephant Infantry, Catapults, Chariots, and Tiger-Leopard Cavalry are yours to command. Utilize a tiered military research tree to gain a technological edge and build unique combat styles based on troop characteristics! 【Internal Management: Grow Even While Offline】 Manage your realm while your armies fight. The Internal Affairs Hall automates the production of grain, gold, and soldiers. Assigning the right generals boosts efficiency, stacking bonuses from city occupation and garrisoning. Every internal decision reflects in your overall national strength! 【Hardcore Challenges: Deep Campaigns, Zero Repetition】 The Campaign Mode rejects mechanical stat-gates. Each level is designed as a tactical puzzle worth pondering. Choose your difficulty and earn differentiated rewards for first clears and masteries. Single battles blend deployment, map events, and plot twists to keep the experience fresh! Step into the Three Kingdoms now and forge your eternal empire!
